Name: (CP) Ballet Body Type
Author: Chloe1202
Description:
[size=4][b]✨🦢 [CP] Chloe's Ballet Body type 🦢✨[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]1. Make sure you have installed the required mods: [b]Content Patcher(nexus1915) [/b]and [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (nexus5098)[/b].
2. Download this mod and extract it.
3. Place it into your [b]Mods[/b] folder. Done! ✅[/color]
中文翻译：[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45254]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45254
[/url]
[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]This body mod features longer legs, creating a more elegant and lightweight look while running, which is why it is named the [i]Ballet Body[/i]. [/color][color=#d5a6bd]The mod includes 3 different height variations, 14 sleeve options, 7 shoe styles, 14 modified vanilla pants, eyelash accessories, shoe color modifications and a mount: Moonflower Seat.[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]Please refer to the images for details.[/color]

✨[color=#b4a7d6]Drop-shoulder sleeve concept inspired by LunariaFaye (nexus profile:[size=1] ﻿[/size][/color][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/LunariaFaye][size=2]https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/LunariaFaye[/size][/url])

[size=4][b]Possible Bugs[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]If you already have other [b]Content Patcher body mods[/b] installed, there may be conflicts affecting [b]sleeves or skin colors[/b].[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]If you have another [b]CP horse retexture[/b] installed that hides the character’s legs, you may encounter a bug where the character has [b]no legs while sitting or riding[/b].[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]To fix these issue, please try turning off or removing any potentially conflicting mods.[/color]
